parameters.prompt: A close-up realistic video of a bright red miniature toy car, fully visible in the center of the image throughout the entire video. In the background, a softly blurred bookshelf and a warm desk lamp create a cozy room. Soft window light reveals reflections on the red paint and the texture of the dark wood. A single continuous shot, realistic miniature photography, gentle natural motion.
